summary: Jena raised on-street parking fees by 50 percent from 1 February 2025 (city centre EUR 3.00 per hour, Zone 2 EUR 1.50, Zone 3 EUR 0.75) and resident permits from EUR 30.70 to EUR 120 a year; the city said the aim is to get visitors to use multi-storey and underground garages more. A February 2022 council paper called extending resident parking costly and not refinanceable and put a planned garage of about 450 spaces on the Seidelstraße car park at at least EUR 11 million, and in July 2022 the council asked the mayor to show options for about 200 car spaces at Inselplatz. Garages include the Contipark-run Universitätsklinikum garage (1,300 spaces, EUR 2.20 per started hour) and the Goethe Galerie garage, listed with 740 spaces by APCOA but 523 on the city page, and the city's parking page shows live free-space counts for some garages as part of a new parking guidance system.

items.text: City of Jena raised on-street parking meter rates by 50% across all three zones from 1 February 2025: Zone 1 (city centre) from EUR 2.00 to EUR 3.00 per hour, Zone 2 from EUR 1.00 to EUR 1.50, Zone 3 from EUR 0.50 to EUR 0.75 (announcement dated 11 December 2024).
items.source_title: Adjustment of parking fees in Jena - for the climate and more quality of stay | Jena Rathaus

items.text: The new Parkgebührenordnung, published in the Amtsblatt on 23 January 2025 and in force from 01.02.2025, sets EUR 3.00/hour (Parkzone 1), EUR 1.50/hour (Zone 2) and EUR 0.75/hour (Zone 3), with a maximum of EUR 4.50 per day at the car parks Seidelparkplatz, Wiesenstraße and Am Gries.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt der Stadt Jena 3/25 (23. Januar 2025)

items.text: Resident parking permit fee in Jena rose from EUR 30.70 to a uniform EUR 120 per year from 1 February 2025, because federal and Thuringian rules now allow fees that reflect the privileged use of public space rather than only administrative cost.
items.source_title: Adjustment of parking fees from 01.02.2025 | Jena Mobilität

items.text: The city said the increase aims to 'motivate visitors to our city to use the multi-storey and underground parking lots more than before'; it noted that, at EUR 3/hour, Zone 1 street parking now costs more than a single bus/tram ticket (EUR 2.70), and that private garages average about EUR 1 to 2.50 per hour. Revenue is earmarked for climate measures such as charging points and photovoltaics.
items.source_title: Adjustment of parking fees in Jena - for the climate and more quality of stay | Jena Rathaus

items.text: On 23 February 2022 the city council decided that new resident-parking zones will only be ordered if the required additional finance and staff can be created, and that the 2010 Parkraumkonzept (evaluated 2018) and the 2017 Mobilitätskonzept Jena-Zentrum und Jena-West remain the working basis. The administration reported that extending resident parking is costly and not refinanceable, and did not recommend a trial of mixed parking.
items.source_title: Beschlussvorlage Nr. 21/1255-BV: Ergebnis Prüfauftrag zur Anpassung des Parkraumkonzeptes

items.text: The same council paper lists three central resident parking zones (Innenstadt since 1992, Westvorstadt and Damenviertel since 1997) plus decentral zones (Seidelparkplatz since 2011, Emma-Heintz-Straße since 2013, Ziegesarstraße since 2019), and says building on the large surface car parks (Inselplatz/Lutherplatz, Eichplatz, Schlossgasse) reduces resident parking spaces mainly in the city centre (Zone 1).
items.source_title: Beschlussvorlage Nr. 21/1255-BV: Ergebnis Prüfauftrag zur Anpassung des Parkraumkonzeptes

items.text: The council paper states that an updated Parkgebührenordnung took effect on 01.01.2022 (the previous adjustment was in 2013), and that in 2021 the council (Beschluss 21/0781-BV) instructed the administration to raise income from parking management by EUR 200,000 per year.
items.source_title: Beschlussvorlage Nr. 21/1255-BV: Ergebnis Prüfauftrag zur Anpassung des Parkraumkonzeptes

items.text: Jena's municipal parking garage then in planning at Inselplatz was expected to cost 'deutlich über 40T€ pro Stellplatz'; a garage of about 450 spaces on the Seidelstraße car park was put at at least EUR 11 million, and a 2018 economic study found it could not be refinanced. The Seidelstraße plan stalled after a citizens' initiative in Kernberge and lack of political majority and funding.
items.source_title: Beschlussvorlage Nr. 21/1255-BV: Ergebnis Prüfauftrag zur Anpassung des Parkraumkonzeptes

items.text: On 13 July 2022 (Beschluss 22/1534-BV) the city council changed the city-centre parking concept: the Inselplatz parking facility is to be reduced, partly offset by an extra underground level at Eichplatz Baufeld A and land reserved for possible garages at Anger 26 and the Seidelstraße car park; the mayor was asked to show options for about 200 car spaces at Inselplatz.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt der Stadt Jena 34/22 (25. August 2022)

items.text: The justification of the 13 July 2022 resolution (Amtsblatt 34/22, 25 August 2022) cites the 'weitgehende Leerstand' (largely empty) Wiesencenter garage next to the Inselplatz site, whose spaces are 'ganztägig weitgehend leer' on several levels. It says the planned changes create a calculated parking deficit in the eastern city centre, but that whether it becomes real once all planned projects are in operation 'remains to be seen' and the situation could change.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt der Stadt Jena 34/22 (25. August 2022)

items.text: The Inselplatz competition result for the new university campus had provided for a garage on 'Am Anger' to cover the campus's parking need and replace the former surface spaces on the Inselplatz wasteland; the city later said building a pure garage there looked uneconomic at current construction prices.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt der Stadt Jena 34/22 (25. August 2022)

items.text: Friedrich Schiller University's Campus Inselplatz in central Jena has been under construction since March 2020; the university says the EU-co-financed buildings (Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the computer centre) were completed in 2024 and the remaining buildings will be completed by end-2026 (page undated).
items.source_title: campus Inselplatz | Uni Jena

items.text: On 7 August 2024 the city received the Thuringian State Administration Office's approval, without objections, of the development plan for the Eichplatz area (page dated 9 August 2024); the final step was public announcement in the official gazette. The council had approved the weighing decision, the implementation agreement and the resolution on the Eichplatz development in construction site A on 24 April 2024.
items.source_title: State administrative office confirms Eichplatz planning | Jena Rathaus

items.text: Jena's city site says the fundamental expansion of Naumburger Straße including the tram extension to Himmelreich was due to begin on 2 March 2026 (weather permitting) and is expected to last until June 2029, with a full road closure from 2 March to 30 November 2026; total cost is about EUR 53.8 million gross, with federal and state subsidies of up to 75 percent possible for infrastructure measures.
items.source_title: Fundamental expansion of Naumburger Straße | Jena Rathaus

items.text: The city's parking page shows live free-space counts for some garages and says the service 'will be gradually extended to other parking lots and parking garages as part of the new parking guidance system'. It listed (free/total): Goethe Galerie 246/523, Krautgasse 121/200, Eichplatz 66/300, Holzmarkt 61/120, Seidelparkplatz 48/161, Neue Mitte 0/165 (live snapshot, undated).
items.source_title: Parking | Jena Mobilität

items.text: The city states Jena has no public park-and-ride system (parking ticket = local transport ticket); it points drivers to outer lots with cheap day tickets (Seidelparkplatz, Wiesenstraße, Am Gries, max EUR 4.50 per day).
items.source_title: Parking | Jena Mobilität

items.text: Electric vehicles with an 'E' on the licence plate may park free of charge in marked spaces, even when not charging, at the city's Schlossgasse, Ernst-Haeckel-Straße, Am Anger, Eichplatz and Rathausgasse parking areas.
items.source_title: Parking | Jena Mobilität

items.text: Stadtwerke Energie Jena-Pößneck operated 470 charging points in October 2024, of which 110 were public eco-power points and 360 were for households, tenants and businesses; the article reports a goal of raising the number of all charging points in Jena to just under 1,500 by 2030 and puts the utility's investment volume for charging points at around EUR 500,000 in 2024.
items.source_title: Jena peilt für 2030 rund 1.500 Ladepunkte an

items.text: Stadtwerke Jena lowered public charging prices from 1 January 2026 to 49 ct/kWh AC (from 52) and 59 ct/kWh DC (from 62); the report cites more than 120 public charging points.
items.source_title: Stadtwerke Jena senken Preis für Ladestrom

items.text: Contipark operates the garage at the Universitätsklinikum Jena (open since May 2016, 1,300 covered spaces, open 365 days, 24 hours), covering operation, management and the technical systems such as barriers and pay machines.
items.source_title: PARKEN am Universitätsklinikum Jena - Parkhaus (Flyer, Stand: Mai 2026)

items.text: Universitätsklinikum Jena garage (Contipark) tariff as of May 2026: EUR 2.20 per started hour, EUR 12.00 maximum per 24 hours, EUR 6.50 per further day; multi-day tickets EUR 14 (2 days), EUR 35 (7 days), EUR 50 (14 days).
items.source_title: PARKEN am Universitätsklinikum Jena - Parkhaus (Flyer, Stand: Mai 2026)

items.text: APCOA operates the Goethe Galerie garage (Ernst-Abbe-Straße 15): APCOA lists 740 spaces, open Mon-Sat 6:00-22:00, EUR 1.50 first and second hour, EUR 2.00 each further hour, EUR 20 daily maximum (undated operator page; city page lists 523 spaces).
items.source_title: Goethe Galerie - APCOA

items.text: A parking directory lists Parkhaus Krautgasse (Krautgasse 22) as operated by Contipark Parkgaragengesellschaft mbH: 381 spaces, open 24 hours, EUR 2.00/hour with EUR 13 daily maximum, monthly EUR 145.18 (undated third-party listing; the city's page shows capacity 200).
items.source_title: Parkhaus Krautgasse - Jena
